question: Can the fixed-n j-to-infinity passage and the anchored-n comparison be composed into one compact-time local-correlation budget without changing PAH-001?

fixed_inputs.model: Exactly the immutable PAH-001 functional, original labelled Gibbs state and original stochastic rates.
fixed_inputs.preregistration: PAH-OMC-020 with the explicit j-before-anchored-n order and no diagonal shortcut.
fixed_inputs.target: The R-512 minimal closed-form semigroup T_min(t), used only as a named target until process identification is proved.
fixed_inputs.time: Compact intervals of external stochastic Markov time; no quantum, proper or Lorentzian interpretation.
fixed_inputs.normalization: Original labelled Gibbs normalization; R-490 C_sw remains a domination input only.
fixed_inputs.observables: Every bounded local cylinder pair for which the registered fixed-n and local-tail hypotheses are instantiated.

symbols.C_nj: sup_{0<=t<=T} stationary finite-j correlation error at level (n,j)
symbols.c_n: fixed-n stationary correlation after the registered j limit
symbols.K_nm: known truncation budget collecting R-510 state passage, R-493 stabilization and R-517 boundary terms

hypotheses.statement: For each fixed n and admissible bounded local f,g, J_nj tends to zero as j tends to infinity uniformly on [0,T].

For every local f,g and truncation m, the anchored comparison has a nonnegative known budget K_nm whose limsup in n tends to zero as m tends to infinity; R-510/R-493/R-517 must instantiate it without an unproved uniformity step.
The target-process/R-512 minimal-form defect D_n is nonnegative and tends to zero in the anchored n limit.

exact_budget.proof: Apply the triangle C_(n,j) -> c_n -> intermediate truncated target -> c_star and take the compact-time supremum; all three terms are retained.
exact_budget.ordered_consequence: H-J plus lim_m limsup_n K_nm=0 and D_n->0 imply lim_n lim_j sup_t |C_(n,j)-c_star|=0 in the preregistered order.
exact_budget.necessity: Dropping K or D is unsound: exact rational hostile fixtures leave a positive correlation error while the retained terms are zero.

known_inputs.R-510: Projective local-state Cauchy modulus and transfer normalization.
known_inputs.R-493: Eventual finite grade-blind local generator stabilization.
known_inputs.R-517: Conditional connected-word boundary attribution with b_eff=288.
known_inputs.R-514: Fixed-n uniform compact-time j passage to Q_n(t).
known_inputs.R-512: Minimal closed form is the named target but does not supply temporal selection.

missing_assumptions: Source-authorized uniform K_nm truncation bound for every bounded local cylinder and compact external-time horizon.
Source-authorized path-space or common-Hilbert construction needed to define the K_nm intermediate and the R-512 target process.
Source-authorized D_n defect tending to zero, including N2b/N2c/N4/N2d obligations.

adversarial_review.objection: The rational decay fixtures are numerical PAH uniform estimates.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: they are explicitly test oracles and never replace H-K or H-D.

adversarial_review.objection: R-514 fixed-n convergence automatically identifies the anchored R-512 target.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AGAINST PROMOTION: H-D is a separate target-process/minimal-form field.

adversarial_review.objection: R-517's conditional boundary tail is already the required uniform K_nm.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AGAINST PROMOTION: source authorization and the all-cylinder compact-time uniformity are absent.

adversarial_review.objection: A triangle inequality constructs a path-space process.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the result proves only an implication conditional on H-K and H-D.

adversarial_review.objection: Markov-time compactness is a physical-time prediction.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the external stochastic time firewall remains explicit.

result_policy.promotion_rule: Do not change the parent gate or claim tier unless H-K and H-D are source-authorized and independently verified.
result_policy.revisit_condition: Reopen only when one versioned owner packet instantiates both H-K and H-D, or an exact PAH-specific contradiction to one hypothesis is found.

non_claims: No PAH-OMC-020 anchored-n semigroup convergence theorem is asserted.
No source process, U_n, common Hilbert space, rate, state, carrier, regulator, time interpretation or limit order is changed.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang--Mills or TOE conclusion.
External Markov time is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
